<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a refined crafting material that is used to make the highest tier of marble-work. It's one of the few items that require [[faith]] in order to craft, making them relatively precious. They are also complex, meaning they have a variety of quality levels.

Regarding these varying qualities, {{Quality|copper}} carvings can be utilized within the [[church]], or bought and sold from the vendor [[Cory]], while the {{Quality|silver}} carvings are used in a variety of applications regarding the [[Graveyard]]. The {{Quality|gold}} carvings are only employed during a quest for the [[Bishop]] (and require the Mason perk to achieve); however, with the Game of Crones DLC, they are also used to craft higher-tier marble headstone sculptures.
